name: posh-list-server
_notes: Zero-dependency by default: express/cors/ws/better-sqlite3/nanoid are still small hand-rolled equivalents built on Node core (node:http, node:sqlite, node:crypto), kept that way on purpose rather than pulled back in. web-push is the one deliberate exception — VAPID JWT signing and aes128gcm payload encryption are real crypto worth not hand-rolling. See push.js.
